title: Fix WinnerRecord serialization bug blocking resume and carry-forward
description: WinnerRecord.to_dict() uses key 'round' but __init__() expects 'round_number'. Deserialization crashes on resume with TypeError. This blocks winner carry-forward between rounds (VOYAGE-14) from actually working — the agent cannot resume from saved state or iterate on prior winners.
definition-of-done: 1. WinnerRecord.to_dict() uses 'round_number' key matching __init__() parameter. 2. Resume path has backward-compat shim: if saved JSON has 'round' key, rename to 'round_number' before constructing WinnerRecord. 3. Voyage run can be stopped and resumed without crash.
testing-plan: 1. Start a voyage run, let it complete one round. 2. Stop the process. 3. Resume with --resume flag. 4. Verify state loads without TypeError. 5. Verify prior round winners are injected into next round agents.
